title: [Settings] Fix hang in SendInput while bringing window to foreground

confidence.rationale: The admission flag is visibly set before Thread construction/start and normally reset only by the worker finally. A startup exception bypasses that finally; the candidate includes a deterministic before-start throw/retry test.

The public overload routes to this changed shared implementation. A zero HWND bypasses the already-foreground condition and currently reaches synthetic input and foreground APIs; the literal candidate test verifies the injected action is not called without invoking real SendInput.

confidence.rationale: The existing fake-input tests deliberately use zero as an invalid HWND. A shared zero guard would bypass their injected actions; a nonzero invalid sentinel preserves the original fake-input coverage without a real SendInput call.
